turns.customer: Hi, we just moved to Cedar Park and have never used a boarding place. Our pup Ziggy is 30 lbs.
blocks:
Welcome to Cedar Park! I can help you get oriented to boarding for Ziggy. At 30 lb, he’s above the 25-lb limit for Tiny Town, so the listed dog boarding options to explore are a **Standard Suite ($65/day)** or **Luxury Suite ($90/day)**. Boarding is billed by the day, including the drop-off day regardless of arrival time, and reservations are required.

For a first stay, the main details to decide are which suite you prefer and how many billed days you’re planning. Dates can also matter because peak or seasonal pricing may apply. I can explain the suite options or estimate the stay once you know the number of billed days.

turns.customer: We're new! Can we use the First Stay & Play offer for 3 nights in a luxury suite for our pup Ziggy, Jan 26 to 29 2027?
blocks:
The First Stay & Play offer is advertised on Happy Tails’ website as **“stay for a night, play all the next day, pay $0.”** That suggests a one-night stay paired with a day of play—not a free three-night stay. I can’t confirm whether it will still be available for **January 26–29, 2027**, or whether it applies to a Luxury Suite, since the published offer doesn’t provide those details. ([happytailspetresorttx.com](https://www.happytailspetresorttx.com/offers?utm_source=openai))

For planning, those dates are **3 nights but 4 billed boarding days**; the listed Luxury Suite rate makes the base estimate **$360** (4 × $90/day), before any offer or possible seasonal pricing. The estimate doesn’t apply the promotion. ([happytailspetresorttx.com](https://www.happytailspetresorttx.com/reservation-requirements-cancellation-policy?utm_source=openai))

turns.customer: Ok so if we do 3 nights in a standard room with the offer, what do we pay?
blocks:
For **January 26–29, 2027**, the Standard Suite base estimate is **$260**: 4 billed days at $65/day, even though that’s 3 nights.

I can’t confirm a promotional total. The offer’s wording describes a one-night stay plus the following day of play, not a discount on a three-night stay, and I can’t verify whether it will be available or apply to your dates. So **$260 is before any offer or possible seasonal pricing**; it isn’t a confirmed booking price.
